steps.name: implement-stage27c-sd-datalogger
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller agent-control
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "08e9ead56e41feff3dc26b55123db912582dd141"
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/20260902-stage27c-sd-datalogger-v1.py | python3
.venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.h src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.cpp src/climate/telemetry/Stage27Telemetry.h src/climate/telemetry/Stage27Telemetry.cpp src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp test/test_stage27_telemetry/test_main.cpp || true
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh src/CMakeLists.txt test/host/CMakeLists.txt src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.h src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.cpp src/climate/telemetry/Stage27Telemetry.h src/climate/telemetry/Stage27Telemetry.cpp src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp test/test_stage27_telemetry/test_main.cpp tools/stage27c_soak.py tests/test_stage27c_soak.py
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: focused-sd-telemetry-tests
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_stage27c_soak.py -q
bash -n scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --target stage27_telemetry_tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R '^stage27_telemetry_tests$' --output-on-failure
grep -q 'GROWBOX_STAGE27_SD_ENABLED=1' scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -q 'MOSI_GPIO=40' scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -q 'MISO_GPIO=13' scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -q 'SCLK_GPIO=39' scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -q 'SD_CS_GPIO=10' scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -q 'outputs=fake-locked' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-gate-build-publish-and-port-preflight
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_stage27c_soak.py -q
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure
git diff --check
git add scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh src/CMakeLists.txt test/host/CMakeLists.txt src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.h src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.cpp src/climate/telemetry/Stage27Telemetry.h src/climate/telemetry/Stage27Telemetry.cpp src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp test/test_stage27_telemetry/test_main.cpp tools/stage27c_soak.py tests/test_stage27c_soak.py
git commit -m 'Add Stage27C SD telemetry datalogger'
NEW_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "[AGENT_PROGRESS] stage27c_sd_source_sha=$NEW_SHA"
bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh clean
GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA="$NEW_SHA" bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build
grep -q "GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA:STRING=$NEW_SHA" build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/CMakeCache.txt
test -f build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/growbox_ml_controller.bin
echo '[AGENT_PROGRESS] stage27c_serial_port_inventory'
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from serial.tools import list_ports
for port in sorted(list_ports.comports(), key=lambda item: item.device):
    vid = f'{port.vid:04X}' if port.vid is not None else '----'
    pid = f'{port.pid:04X}' if port.pid is not None else '----'
    print(f'PORT device={port.device} vidpid={vid}:{pid} manufacturer={port.manufacturer!r} product={port.product!r} serial={port.serial_number!r} location={port.location!r}')
PY
CROWPANEL_PORT="$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')"
echo "CROWPANEL_CH340_PORT=$CROWPANEL_PORT"
PROBE="$(esptool.py --port "$CROWPANEL_PORT" chip_id 2>&1)"
echo "$PROBE"
grep -q 'ESP32-S3' <<<"$PROBE"
echo "CROWPANEL_ESP32S3_VERIFIED=$CROWPANEL_PORT"
git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
test -z "$(git status --short)"
echo "PUBLISHED_SHA=$NEW_SHA"
